wholePhysicalScope: Sixteen native structure outlines across the main temple, the two distinct entrance towers, central joining halls, peripheral courtyards and separate south glazed paifang.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the covered hall ranges, courtyard openings, paired entrance towers and detached seven-roof paifang. Near levels add bracket blocks, steles, stepped approaches and latticework.
limitations: Native OpenStreetMap controls establish sixteen compound building envelopes. Main roof breaks, axial openings, woodwork, minor roof finishes, steps and floor and ridge elevations are inferred from the cleared photographs and written descriptions.

The seven-roof Ming paifang is placed approximately at the mouth of Shenlu Street, across Chaoyangmenwai Avenue. Authorities give its overall width and approximate height. Its depth and small moulding profiles are estimated.
Representative stele positions and exterior paving are simplified. Interior exhibits, carved inscriptions, statues, foliage and minor fixtures are outside the modeled scope.
Foundations follow the frozen original source field with local averaging per building. Terrain samples do not resolve individual courtyard steps or foundation heights.
